WITH origin AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-74.004314 40.748756)',4326) AS pt
),
nearby_tiles AS (
  SELECT d.rast
  FROM public.dem_us d, origin o
  WHERE d.rast && ST_Expand(o.pt, 1.0)
),
masked AS (
	  SELECT ST_MapAlgebra(
	           rast,
	           1,
	           '32BF'::text,
	           'CASE WHEN [rast.val] < 100 THEN [rast.val] ELSE NULL END'::text,
	           NULL::double precision
	         ) AS rast
  FROM nearby_tiles
),
qualifying_pixels AS (
  SELECT (pp).geom AS geom
  FROM masked
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL ST_PixelAsCentroids(rast, 1, TRUE) AS pp
)
SELECT MIN(ST_Distance(p.geom::geography, o.pt::geography)) AS distance_m
FROM qualifying_pixels p, origin o;

WITH poi_geom AS (
  SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-74.004314, 40.748756), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
elevation_raster AS (
  SELECT rast
  FROM public.dem_us
  WHERE ST_Intersects(
    rast,
    ST_Envelope(ST_Transform(poi_geom.geom, 3857))
  )
),
elevation_points AS (
  SELECT
    (ST_PixelAsPoints(rast, 1)).*
  FROM elevation_raster, poi_geom
  WHERE ST_Distance(ST_Transform(poi_geom.geom, 3857), ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(x, y), 4326), 3857)) < 100000
),
filtered_points AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM elevation_points
  WHERE value < 100
),
nearest_point AS (
  SELECT
    MIN(ST_Distance(ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(x, y), 4326), 3857), ST_Transform(poi_geom.geom, 3857))) AS distance_meters
  FROM filtered_points, poi_geom
)
SELECT
  ROUND(distance_meters) AS distance_to_low_elevation_point_meters
FROM nearest_point;
